entities.name: Satya
entities.description: Human artificer from Avishkar who invented the Aetherflux Reservoir.

entities.name: Avaati Vya
entities.description: Inventor and Satya's partner, credited with discovering how to harness aether.

entities.name: Great Aether Boom
entities.description: Era of aether refinement Satya helped launch.

events.summary: Satya and Avaati Vya together launched the Great Aether Boom while Satya let Avaati take the spotlight.
events.quote: Satya himself remained largely indifferent to public acclaim

relations.quote: known primarily as the inventive mind behind the creation of the Aetherflux Reservoir
their achievements were the product of a close partnership
